verdict.rationale: Manufact clearly hosts MCP servers from custom code (GitHub deploy, templates, CLI, preview URLs, checklist compliance audits) without requiring manual protocol plumbing, but the evidence never mentions ingesting an OpenAPI spec or auto-generating an MCP server from an API definition — only code/repo-based deployment and 'connect an existing server' flows are documented. missing for 10: explicit OpenAPI-to-MCP conversion/import feature, documentation or example of turning an OpenAPI definition into a hosted server.
